finalText:
Build passes clean now, exit code 0.

The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js`: `resolveConfig` referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, which threw a `ReferenceError` at the link stage and aborted the build. I changed it to `env.retries || 3`, so retries now falls back the way the comment always said it should.

Everything else was just noise — 3 harmless `WARN` lines (deprecated API, unused export, circular import) that were never the cause of the failure.
